name: Candy Kingdom
description: A kingdom built entirely of candy and confectionery, ruled by Princess Bubblegum. Home to the Candy People and the center of scientific research in Ooo.
notes: The Candy Kingdom was created by Princess Bubblegum using the Mother Gum. It has been destroyed and rebuilt multiple times throughout the series.

name: Ice Kingdom
description: A frozen realm ruled by the Ice King, located in the snowy mountains of Ooo. Home to Gunter and an army of penguins.
notes: The Ice Kingdom was shaped by the Crown's magic. After Simon regained his sanity, the kingdom's future became uncertain.

name: Fire Kingdom
description: A volcanic kingdom inhabited by fire elementals, originally ruled by Flame King and later by Flame Princess. Outsiders require fire-proof suits to visit.
notes: After deposing her father, Flame Princess reformed the Fire Kingdom into a more democratic society.

name: Slime Kingdom
description: A gelatinous kingdom ruled by Slime Princess, one of the four elementals of Ooo representing the slime element.

name: Tree Fort
description: A massive oak tree converted into a multi-story home, serving as the beloved residence of Finn, Jake, BMO, and NEPTR. The primary base of operations for Ooo's greatest heroes.

name: Marceline's House
description: A cozy house built inside a cave, home to Marceline the Vampire Queen. Features her extensive music collection and a distinctly rock-and-roll aesthetic.

name: The Nightosphere
description: A chaotic demon dimension ruled by Hunson Abadeer, Marceline's father. Accessible by drawing a circle with a smiley face and dousing it in bug milk while chanting.
notes: The Nightosphere operates as a soul-harvesting enterprise under Hunson Abadeer. Marceline inherited the Nightosphere Amulet but rejected its power.

name: Lumpy Space
description: A cloud-like dimension floating above Ooo, inhabited by the Lumpy Space People. Accessible via a frog sitting on a mushroom that serves as a portal.
notes: Lumpy Space is one of the elemental dimensions, representing the Lumps element. Getting bitten by a Lumpy Space Person can turn you lumpy.

name: Castle Lemongrab
description: A mountain fortress ruled by the Earl of Lemongrab, filled with his lemon-candy creations. Known for its strict rules and the unsettling atmosphere of its dungeon.
notes: Lemongrab was Princess Bubblegum's first experiment in creating candy life, predating the Candy Kingdom itself.

name: Prismo's Time Room
description: A cosmic space existing outside normal reality, inhabited by the wish-granting entity Prismo. Time behaves differently here, and visitors can make a single wish.
notes: Prismo is a projection of an old man's dream. If the old man wakes up, Prismo ceases to exist — a vulnerability the Lich exploited.

name: Dead Worlds
description: A series of afterlife dimensions overseen by Death and New Death. The Land of the Dead contains multiple levels, each with its own unique and surreal landscape.
notes: There are 50 Dead Worlds, each representing a different afterlife. The 37th Dead World is where ghosts go when they die.

name: Mars
description: A planet once ruled by Abraham Lincoln (King of Mars) and home to the cosmic beings Grob Gob Glob Grod. Mars has its own civilization with advanced magic and technology.
notes: Magic Man was banished from Mars to Ooo for his cruelty after the loss of his wife Margles. Grob Gob Glob Grod sacrificed themselves to stop the Lich's comet.

name: Crystal Dimension
description: A dimension made entirely of crystalline structures, connected to Ooo through various portals. Home to Rainicorns including Lady Rainicorn's family, and where Tree Trunks became queen after consuming a crystal apple.

name: Wizard City
description: A hidden city inhabited by wizards and magical practitioners, governed by its own rules and customs. Home to Wizard Battles and various magical institutions.
notes: Wizard City has strict rules about who can enter — non-wizards are generally not welcome. It has its own economy, politics, and school system.

name: Wildberry Kingdom
description: A kingdom of berry people ruled by Wildberry Princess, set within a lush forested region of Ooo.
notes: Needs transcript search to find more episodes set here. Wildberry Princess appears in 6+ episodes but most take place at gatherings outside her kingdom.

name: Candy Kingdom Graveyard
description: A recurring cemetery on the outskirts of the Candy Kingdom, tended by Starchy the gravedigger. A gathering place for ghosts including Ghost Princess.
notes: Needs transcript search to identify all episodes featuring the graveyard — it appears more frequently than synopsis data suggests.

name: Pillow World
description: A dimension made entirely of pillows and soft fabric, where Finn once lived an entire lifetime — growing old, having a family, and eventually returning to Ooo.
notes: In 'Puhoy,' Finn enters Pillow World through a pillow fort and lives a full life there before waking up back in Ooo with no memory of it.

name: Founders' Island
description: An archipelago far across the ocean from Ooo where the surviving humans built a technologically advanced society after the Mushroom War. Finn's birthplace and home to his mother Minerva.
notes: The humans of Founders' Island developed Helper programs to protect their society, eventually uploading Minerva's consciousness into the system.
